verdict.rationale: Rippling's identity marketing claims agents live in the same identity system as people, which touches the core 'agents as first-class identities' idea, but it is a single thin claim with no documented patterns. The scoped Bearer API tokens (owner permissions intersected with token scopes) secure access to Rippling's own API, not agent access to other apps, so they are an adjacent building block. Missing for 10: documented cross-app access patterns for agents, token vaulting, scoped per-agent credentials, agent lifecycle/governance docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, AI agents are first-class identities — documented patterns for securing agent access to apps (cross-app access, token vaulting, scoped agent credentials)

citations.quote: Rippling is the only identity solution with your people and agents in one system—so access always reflects reality
